preservationMethod: Recovered after the correction by inverting only its five local SAI byte-mask substitutions. The resulting bytes match the pre-correction SHA256 recorded before runtime qualification.
qualificationScope: Earlier engine candidate runs retain their original source pins. This snapshot does not alter their results. R14/R15 SAI MMIO operations use32-bit writes; narrow transactions require the corrected source.
correction: Mask SAI write side effects to the actual bus byte lanes before W1C, FR or unsupported-operation checks.
